newsitem.title: USA: Chevron to buy 2 double hull tankers.
newsitem.headline: Chevron to buy 2 double hull tankers.

text.p: Chevron Corp said it agreed to acquire two new-build, double hull tankers as part of a fleet renewal program for Chevron Shipping Company.
Financing for the vessels has been arranged by Cambridge Partners L.L.C., a New York based investment bank.

A Cambridge subsidiary will own the vessels and Chevron Shipping will operate them under a bareboat charter agreement. The initial charter term will be eight years, with five two-year Chevron options out to 18 years.
The carriers (VLCC's) are to be built by Samsung Heavy Industries Co Ltd..
